hardlink_entanglement_incident.discovered_by: This fix round, in response to review finding 'adaptive.json:11,22,35,61 ... made adaptive-paper-r20260925 and nautilus-2.0.0rc5-r20260925 share inodes with tools/adaptive-paper-20260921'.
hardlink_entanglement_incident.note_on_which_root: This root's entanglement was with the FORBIDDEN live paper venv tools/adaptive-paper-20260921 (via the nautilus-trader/numpy/pandas/six/python-dateutil versions this install shares with that venv's package set -- corrected round 3 to include nautilus-trader itself, see root_cause above), not with the existing_root_untouched named above (tools/nautilus-2.0.0rc5); a direct inode comparison against tools/nautilus-2.0.0rc5 found 0 shared inodes, so that root's own 'existing_root_modified: false' claim (below) was never at risk. The at-risk claim was isolation.existing_root_modified for the live venv, which this receipt did not previously mention at all.
hardlink_entanglement_incident.root_cause: The original install command above did not pass --link-mode, so uv 0.12.17's Linux default (hardlink from the shared ~/.cache/uv content-addressed cache) made this root's files hardlinks to the same cache-backed inodes already used by tools/adaptive-paper-20260921. CORRECTED IN ROUND 3: this was not limited to numpy/pandas/six/python-dateutil as previously stated -- nautilus_trader==2.0.0rc5 itself is also installed in the live venv (adaptive-paper.json's own package_set includes it), at the identical pinned version this root installs, so uv's content-addressed cache hardlinked its files too. See root_cause_package_accounting_round3 for the corrected, independently-verified breakdown; the understatement (naming only the 4 indirect dependency packages) is a previously-undisclosed gap in round 2's own receipt, not a re-measurement of what actually happened (the pre-fix root no longer exists to re-inspect directly).

root_cause_package_accounting_round3.installed_distributions_all_five: nautilus_trader, numpy, pandas, python-dateutil, six -- all 5 are the complete installed_distributions list below; ALL 5 are also present in the live venv at the identical pinned version (adaptive-paper.json's package_set), so all 5 were candidates for cache-based hardlinking, not just the 4 previously named.
root_cause_package_accounting_round3.current_root_file_count_by_package: Measured directly on the current (already-copy-mode-fixed) root, since the pre-fix hardlinked state no longer exists to re-inspect: of 2592 non-__pycache__ site-packages files, nautilus_trader accounts for 104 (path contains '/nautilus_trader'), numpy 940, pandas 1523, six 8, python-dateutil(dateutil) 27 -- these overlap slightly (e.g. a handful of shared .libs/RECORD-adjacent paths), so they do not sum to exactly 2592, but nautilus_trader's 104 files are unambiguously present and none of them are numpy/pandas/six/dateutil files.
root_cause_package_accounting_round3.arithmetic_consistency_with_pre_fix_coun: measured_before_fix.result below records 2575 of 2593 files shared pre-fix -- more than the ~2486 files round 2's own review estimate attributed to numpy+pandas+six+dateutil alone (and more than can be accounted for without nautilus_trader, given nautilus_trader is 104 of this root's 2592-2593 files and the only OTHER installed package). This is consistent with, not merely asserted from, at least part of nautilus_trader's own 104 files having been among the 2575 shared pre-fix; the exact split is not independently re-measurable now that the root is already fixed (copy-mode, 0 shared inodes), so this receipt states the corrected mechanism (all 5 packages were candidates, not 4) without a false-precision exact count for nautilus_trader specifically.
